posthuistheater.scrape_code:
import requests, re
from datetime import datetime
for pg in range(1, 10):
    url = f"https://www.posthuistheater.nl/agenda/?page={pg}" if pg > 1 else "https://www.posthuistheater.nl/agenda/"
    r = requests.get(url)
    pairs = re.findall(r'data-production-title="([^"]+)"[^>]*data-event-start="([^"]+)"', r.text)
    pairs += [(t,d) for d,t in re.findall(r'data-event-start="([^"]+)"[^>]*data-production-title="([^"]+)"', r.text)]
    for title, dt_str in pairs:
        try: dt = datetime.fromisoformat(dt_str).date().isoformat()
        except: pass
    if not pairs: break

import requests, re
r = requests.get("https://bostheater.nl/programma")
for art in re.findall(r'<article[^>]*>(.*?)</article>', r.text, re.S):
    h = re.search(r'<h[234][^>]*>(.*?)</h[234]>', art, re.S)
    dt = re.search(r'datetime="(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', art)
    if h and dt:
        title, date_iso = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',h.group(1)).strip(), dt.group(1)

friso.scrape_code:
import urllib.request, json, re
from email.utils import parsedate_to_datetime
from xml.etree.ElementTree import fromstring

def scrape_nevobo(teamcode, geslacht, volgnr, club_name, source_key, gender):
    url = f'https://api.nevobo.nl/export/team/{teamcode}/{geslacht}/{volgnr}/programma.rss'
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as r:
        data = r.read().decode('utf-8')
    data = data.replace('<![CDATA[', '').replace(']]>', '')
    root = fromstring(data)
    events = []
    for item in root.findall('.//item'):
        title = item.findtext('title', '').strip()
        link  = item.findtext('link', '').strip()
        pub   = item.findtext('pubDate', '').strip()
        desc  = item.findtext('description', '').strip()
        m = re.match(r'.+?:\s+(.+?)\s+-\s+(.+)', title)
        if not m: continue
        home, away = m.group(1).strip(), m.group(2).strip()
        if club_name not in home: continue
        dt = parsedate_to_datetime(pub)
        venue_m = re.search(r'Speellocatie:\s*(.+)', desc)
        venue = venue_m.group(1).strip() if venue_m else f'Thuishal {club_name}'
        events.append({'title': f'{club_name} - {away}', 'date': dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
            'venue': venue, 'url': link, 'source': source_key,
            'genre': 'sport', 'sport': 'volleybal', 'gender': gender})
    return events

events = scrape_nevobo('ckl6l98', 'dames', 1, 'Friso Sneek', 'friso', 'dames')
friso.notes: Damesteam Eredivisie. Teamcode: ckl6l98 (dames/1). Zie lycurgus voor URL-structuur.

heerenveen.scrape_code:
import urllib.request, re, json as _json

req = urllib.request.Request(
    'https://www.sc-heerenveen.nl/wedstrijden',
    headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'}
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
    html = r.read().decode('utf-8')
# JSON embedded in HTML - find the matches block
m = re.search(r'"matches":\s*(\[.*?\])', html, re.S)
if m:
    matches = _json.loads(m.group(1))
    events = []
    for match in matches:
        if not match.get('isHome', False): continue
        date_played = match.get('datePlayed', '')[:10]
        opponent = match.get('opponent', {}).get('name', 'Onbekend')
        events.append({
            'title': f'SC Heerenveen - {opponent}',
            'date': date_played,
            'venue': 'Abe Lenstra Stadion, Heerenveen',
            'url': 'https://www.sc-heerenveen.nl/wedstrijden',
            'source': 'heerenveen', 'genre': 'sport',
            'sport': 'voetbal', 'gender': 'heren'
        })
heerenveen.notes: Statische HTML met embedded JSON. Zoek op 'datePlayed' keys. isHome:true filtert thuiswedstrijden. 25 thuiswedstrijden seizoen 2025-26. LET OP: niet te verwarren met ESPN - eigen site werkt statisch.

import urllib.request, re

def scrape_espn(espn_url, club_name, venue, source_key):
    req = urllib.request.Request(espn_url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
        html = r.read().decode('utf-8')
    pattern = (
        r'"displayName":"([^"]+)"[^}]{0,300}"isHome":true\}'
        r'.{0,600}'
        r'"displayName":"([^"]+)"[^}]{0,300}"isHome":false\}'
        r'.{0,200}"date":"(202[67]-\\d{2}-\\d{2})'
    )
    events = []
    for m in re.finditer(pattern, html, re.S):
        home, away, date_iso = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
        if club_name.lower() not in home.lower():
            continue
        events.append({
            'title': f'{club_name} - {away}',
            'date': date_iso, 'venue': venue, 'url': espn_url,
            'source': source_key, 'genre': 'sport',
            'sport': 'voetbal', 'gender': 'heren'
        })
    return events
